pending_interview.question: You have a list of log entries, where each entry is a string in the format "user_id:timestamp:action" (for example, "u42:1000:login"). Given this list, write a function that finds every user who performed the same action more than once within any 5-minute window (where timestamps are integers representing seconds). Return a list of (user_id, action) pairs. Walk through your approach, including your choice of data structure and the time complexity of your solution.
